Prompt 23 — Synchronize the diagnostic feedback template with version 14

Context
-------
Read .github/copilot-instructions.md, feedback/README.md,
feedback/airgap-run-template.md, feedback/airgap-run-002.md, and the
actual learner-vm/scripts/00-diagnose.sh.

Prompt 22 changed the diagnostic to perform real image pulls by
default, with `--no-pull-verification` restoring probe-only mode. The
current template may still say v13. This task updates feedback
metadata and instructions only.

This task runs on the connected upstream machine. Do not access the
learner VM or run diagnostics or provisioning scripts against it.

Objective
---------
Ensure the empty first-diagnostic template records the current
diagnostic version and explains the pull-verification side effect.

Task 1 — verify current diagnostic
----------------------------------
Read the actual SCRIPT_VERSION and CHANGE comment in
learner-vm/scripts/00-diagnose.sh. Do not assume it is v14 without
checking.

Task 2 — update the empty run-002 template
------------------------------------------
Inspect feedback/airgap-run-002.md.

- If it is still an empty template, update only its script-version
  metadata line to the actual diagnostic version, using this wording:

    - Script versions run: 00-diagnose v<N> (current repository version; confirm the version in the repository on the VM)

- If it contains a real REPORT block, do not modify the report or its
  metadata. Report that it contains evidence and leave it untouched.

Task 3 — align feedback interpretation guidance
-----------------------------------------------
Check feedback/README.md and feedback/airgap-run-template.md.

Ensure the guidance says:

- The default `00-diagnose.sh` performs real Podman pulls to
  distinguish true image failures from manifest-probe false
  positives. Successful pulls warm the rootful Podman store.
- `--no-pull-verification` restores probe-only mode and does not pull
  or warm images.
- An individual manifest-probe 404 alone is informational; the actual
  pull result determines image availability.
- Missing Skopeo on the minimal base is an expected SKIPPED result;
  script 20 installs it.
- SELinux enforcing and firewalld active are informational. Do not
  advise disabling SELinux; script 20 owns the firewalld decision.
- The diagnostic report should still be pasted completely and
  verbatim, including any FAIL lines.

If the README is already accurate, leave it unchanged. If the
reusable template needs a short note reminding the operator that the
default diagnostic pulls and may warm the image store, add that note
without adding report content.

Constraints
-----------
- Do not modify feedback/airgap-run-001.md.
- Do not modify provisioning scripts, lab-vm.conf, artifacts.tsv,
  resolver code, or image-publisher code.
- Do not stage or commit changes.
- Do not pre-fill or fabricate any report block.
- Do not access the learner VM.

Validation
----------
Report:
- actual diagnostic version and CHANGE comment;
- whether run-002 was updated or preserved because it contains real
  evidence;
- whether feedback README/template required changes;
- `git status --short`.

Acceptance
----------
Capture the following into a single text file:

1. Paste the actual diagnostic version and CHANGE comment.
2. Paste the run-002 version line if it changed.
3. Paste the final diagnostic interpretation section from
   feedback/README.md.
4. Paste `git status --short`.
5. Explicitly state that the learner VM was not accessed and no
   diagnostic or provisioning script was run.
6. Leave all changes uncommitted and unstaged.
